jei.maixr.egg_sewer.hint: Any rotation works; any of the 4 ports accepts FE, can be drained, and opens the UI.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.hint2: Left is the full 3D view; the following 3 pages are per-layer blueprints. Any rotation works.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.info.1: - Build the 3x3x3 from the next 3 pages: 4 nest ports on the middle layer edge midpoints.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.info.2: - The 4 ports give 36 egg slots; eggs tagged #balm:eggs / #forge:eggs / #exoticbirds:eggs.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.info.3: - 10000 FE per 1 mB; rate = eggs x 1 mB/s.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.info.4: - Eggs are not consumed; any port face takes FE and can be drained.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.info.5: - Switch the output between Sewage and Witch Water in the UI.
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.layer.bottom: Layer 1 (bottom): 8x railway casing + center sewage block
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.layer.middle: Layer 2 (middle): hay corners + 4 nest ports + center sewage block
jei.maixr.egg_sewer.title: Artificial Sewage Nest - Multiblock
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.hint: Forms in any orientation; any port can take FE, be drained, or open the UI.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.info.1: - Build the 3x3x3 from the next 3 pages: 4 Pink Nest Ports at mid-layer edge centers.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.info.2: - 36 egg slots total; insert eggs tagged #balm:eggs / #forge:eggs / #exoticbirds:eggs.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.info.3: - 100000 FE produces 1 mB Pink Slime; rate = egg count x 1 mB/s.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.info.4: - Eggs are NOT consumed; any face of any port accepts FE and outputs fluid.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.info.5: - Energy buffer 10000 kFE; single product (Pink Slime), no mode switch.
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.layer.bottom: Layer 1 (bottom): 8x Steel Casing + center Mob Slaughter Factory
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.layer.middle: Layer 2 (middle): 4x Pink Wool corners + 4x Pink Nest Ports + center
jei.maixr.pink_egg_sewer.layer.top: Layer 3 (top): 8x Pink Wool + center Mob Slaughter Factory

maixr.jei.primordial_betrayal.1: How to get: be defeated by a player dual-wielding Swords of the Cosmos. Your armor slots are emptied, and this is worn in your helmet slot after respawn.
maixr.jei.sealed_ta.1: How to get: defeat another player while holding a Sword of the Cosmos in both your main and off hand.
maixr.jei.sealed_ta.2: White as a sigh. Sealed inside is the one you did not want standing up again.
maixr.jei.soul_gem.1: How to get: kill a maid that belongs to you and whose favorability has reached level 1 (64 points). She drops this gem.
maixr.jei.soul_gem.2: She belongs to no one but you. So this is something only you can do.
maixr.lore.primordial_betrayal.1: You woke with nothing on you. Armor, charms, and that little bit of self-assurance - all gone.
maixr.lore.primordial_betrayal.2: Only this was on your head. Cold, heavy, like a hand pressed down saying: remember.
maixr.lore.primordial_betrayal.3: It never drops, and it blocks nothing. It only makes sure you remember every time you look in a mirror.
maixr.lore.primordial_betrayal.4: "I came at the wrong season - it is not him you resent, but the self that has never won."
maixr.lore.sealed_ta.1: He did not shout when he fell. He just looked, strangely, at the two swords in your hands.
maixr.lore.sealed_ta.2: "Since when did killing me require a spare?"
maixr.lore.sealed_ta.3: You did not answer. The white shell closed, sealing the question with him.
maixr.lore.sealed_ta.4: Now every time you show it, it repeats that line for you.
maixr.lore.soul_gem.1: It took her one day to learn your name, and three months to learn to gather your tools before the rain.
maixr.lore.soul_gem.2: All it took from you was one swing. Then your hand held something warm and orange.
maixr.lore.soul_gem.3: It keeps beating, faintly. Like a sentence nobody finished.
maixr.lore.soul_gem.4: "Trading the one you love most for a stone - that math never balances."
